## FIPS 140-3: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules

NIST · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/140-3/final>

Machine-readable: <https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cryptographic-module-validation-program/validated-modules>

**Authoritative for:** Whether a cryptographic module is validated and at what level. Not an opinion about cryptographic quality — a certification fact that federal and many regulated buyers depend on.

## NIST SP 800-57 Part 1: Recommendation for Key Management

NIST · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/57/pt1/r5/final>

**Authoritative for:** Approved algorithms and key lengths, cryptoperiods by key type, and the full key lifecycle. The referee for how long a key may stay in use and whether a length is still acceptable.

## PCI Data Security Standard

PCI Security Standards Council · global · **account required — cite it; the user fetches it**

<https://www.pcisecuritystandards.org/document_library/>

**Authoritative for:** Whether a support agent may take a card number by phone, whether that call may be recorded, and what must happen to card data in ticket attachments and screen shares. Assessed by a qualified assessor, so genuinely dispositive.
